mapper.select: SELECT master.agent_id AS owner_id, master.agent_code AS owner_code, master.agent_name AS owner_name, master.status AS owner_status, mv.version_no, mv.status AS version_status, child.version_no AS referenced_version_no, (master.current_version_id = mv.agent_version_id AND master.status = 'ENABLED') AS active FROM squad_chat.sq_agent_version child JOIN squad_chat.sq_agent_version_subagent delegation ON delegation.subagent_version_id = child.agent_version_id JOIN squad_chat.sq_agent_version mv ON mv.agent_version_id = delegation.master_version_id JOIN squad_chat.sq_agent master ON master.agent_id = mv.agent_id WHERE child.agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY active DESC, master.agent_code, mv.version_no DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE squad_chat.sq_agent SET current_version_id = #{currentVersionId}, revision = revision + 1, last_updater_id = #{lastUpdaterId}, last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND revision = #{revision}

UPDATE squad_chat.sq_agent SET agent_name = #{agentName}, revision = revision + 1, last_updater_id = #{lastUpdaterId}, last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND revision = #{revision}

UPDATE squad_chat.sq_agent a SET status = #{status}, revision = a.revision + 1, last_updater_id = #{lastUpdaterId}, last_update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE a.agent_id = #{agentId} AND a.revision = #{revision}
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM squad_chat.sq_agent_version child JOIN squad_chat.sq_agent_version_subagent delegation ON delegation.subagent_version_id = child.agent_version_id JOIN squad_chat.sq_agent master ON master.current_version_id = delegation.master_version_id WHERE child.agent_id = a.agent_id AND master.status = 'ENABLED' )
UPDATE squad_chat.sq_agent SET status = status WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND status = 'ENABLED'
